faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the UPCBL Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Cooperative Intern position at Uttar Pradesh State Cooperative Bank is 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Cooperative Intern role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA or equivalent degree in Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agriculture Business Management, or Rural Development Management. Computer proficiency with a certificate is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Cooperative Intern position is between 21 years and 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Cooperative Intern position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the UPCBL Cooperative Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their complete application, along with self-attested copies of required documents, via email to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the UPCBL Cooperative Intern posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Cooperative Intern recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job for the Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The Cooperative Intern position is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Cooperative Intern position at the Uttar Pradesh State Cooperative Bank.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Uttar Pradesh State Cooperative Bank located?
faq.answer: The Uttar Pradesh State Cooperative Bank is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 226001.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of the Uttar Pradesh State Cooperative Bank?
faq.answer: The official website of the Uttar Pradesh State Cooperative Bank is www.upcbl.in.
